Regression: home list (5 demo addresses + community-visible TEST-PUB from earlier backend test), map tab (map-screen, map-community-toggle, map-offline-maps-btn all present), address detail (Marie Nkomo, mini leaflet map, GPS coords, verified badge, action-qr), profile screen all OK. ONE bug found: duplicate testID 'pub-cat-other' assigned to both the 'Autre' category chip (via ChoiceRow prefix 'pub-cat' + value 'other') AND the revealed conditional TextInput — this is a testID collision that breaks selector uniqueness.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate testID 'pub-cat-other' shared by (a) the 'Autre' category chip generated by ChoiceRow(..., 'pub-cat') and (b) the conditional TextInput for pub_category_other. Selector [data-testid="pub-cat-other"] returns two elements once 'Autre' is selected — automated tests cannot uniquely target the input, and clicking the selector will hit the chip. Reference: /app/frontend/app/survey/[id].tsx:604 (chip) and :609 (TextInput).

react_native_issues.issue: Persistent RN Web deprecation warnings from earlier iterations still present: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow), 'textShadow*' style props deprecated, 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported' JS fallback. Not caused by this batch — pre-existing across the app. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme/index.ts (Shadows tokens).

action_items: Rename the TextInput on line 609 of /app/frontend/app/survey/[id].tsx from testID='pub-cat-other' to a unique value such as testID='pub-cat-other-input' (or 'pub-category-other') to eliminate the collision with the 'Autre' category chip that ChoiceRow emits with the same testID.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/survey/[id].tsx is 864 lines — approaching the 700-line 'split into modules' guideline. Consider extracting per-step components (HouseholdSteps, CommerceStep, PublicStep, PersonsStep) into src/components/ for maintainability.

Both /api/commerces and /api/addresses (with include_public_commerces=True) now iterate up to 500-2000 documents per request without a compound index on (is_commerce, is_public, owner_id). At field-scale this will slow down; add a Mongo compound index in a startup hook.

server.py CSV export loads all addresses into memory then does a per-address survey lookup — N+1 pattern. Fine at 5-50 rows, will degrade at ~5k+. Consider a single aggregation with $lookup for future scale.

The 'photos' field on Address is Optional[List[dict]] — no shape validation on individual photo entries. Consider a Photo Pydantic model with base64/lat/lng/bearing/taken_at typed fields for safer ingest and CSV column generation.

test_s4_bifurcation.py had a stale assertion that broke against the new v3 behavior (/commerces returns public buildings too). Fixed inline. Main agent should audit any other tests that pre-date the survey_type='public' feature.

rca_of_issue: pub-cat-other testID collision RCA: /app/frontend/app/survey/[id].tsx line 595-604 renders the 8 public-service category chips via ChoiceRow with testIdPrefix='pub-cat' → each chip gets testID `pub-cat-${value}`, so the 'Autre' chip gets 'pub-cat-other'. Line 609 then renders a conditional TextInput (shown only when category === 'other') with the exact same testID 'pub-cat-other'. Both live in the DOM simultaneously once 'Autre' is selected, so any selector matches two nodes. Reproduction: navigate /survey/{id} → Service public card → click 'Autre' chip → both `document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="pub-cat-other"]').length === 2`. Mitigation: change line 609 to `testID="pub-cat-other-input"` (or `"pub-category-other"`) and update any downstream Playwright scripts. No functional user impact today — the input still renders and saves correctly — but every automated test targeting the input will click the chip instead.
